checks: Only the isolated emulator is used
DownloadManager preserves its job while the app process is killed
Source APK is removed only after a complete fsynced session copy
Staged installer session survives app process recreation
Real confirmation Intent resolves to the system installer and original session
System unknown-source settings return to the pending installation
Cancel leaves the original app installed
Cancel does not leave the downloaded source APK
MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED restores the successful update state

observations.scope: Separate disposable fixture package exercises standard Android APIs. It does not bypass Wbox production signature/metadata validation or install a new Wbox release.
observations.discarded_capture: The unknown-source screenshot was taken before its dialog frame appeared; it was excluded. The setting transition and return to installation were verified by the successful UI actions and subsequent installer callback.
